title: Part History words a Min-only change and a Min and Max change correctly
custom_preconds:
• Signed in as Admin. A tracked part with Min 1 / Max 2.
  • Parts > Inventory, search the part.
custom_steps:
1. Open the part, set Min 5 and Max 15, Save.
  2. Open the part, set only Min to 1 (leave Max 15), Save.
  3. Click the row history icon.
custom_expected:
Step 3:

  • Newest entry: "Min/Max updated | Min: 5 → 1 | Source: Edit Part", with no Max part.
  • Earlier entry: "Min/Max updated | Min: 1 → 5 | Max: 2 → 15 | Source: Edit Part" (Min first, then Max, joined by " | ").
  • Each entry has Staff, Date and Time.
